name: @backlinedev/backline
description: Runtime behavior previews for pull requests - compare API and CLI outputs between PR and base branch
author: Ummara Ali Syeda <syeda.umm@northeastern.edu>

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module';const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module';const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/cli.js
